rattata-crunch.name: Crunch
rattata-crunch.description: Bond skill: crunches a foe with its fangs (Power 100, Attack), leaving it Exposed for 2 turns.

rattata-sucker-punch.name: Sucker Punch
rattata-sucker-punch.description: Bond skill: darts at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 70) and engages it.

rattata-endeavor.name: Endeavor
rattata-endeavor.description: Bond skill: a desperate, all-out assault on a foe (Power 80).

rattata-guts.name: Guts
rattata-guts.description: Deals 25% more damage while it carries a status.

rattata-scavenger.name: Scavenger
rattata-scavenger.description: Heals 10% of max HP when it knocks out a foe.

rattata-focus-energy.name: Focus Energy
rattata-focus-energy.description: New skill: takes a deep breath; it is Focused for 2 turns.

rattata-pursuit.name: Pursuit
rattata-pursuit.description: New skill: chases a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 50) and engages it.

rattata-pack-rat.name: Pack Rat
rattata-pack-rat.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes engaged with one of its allies.

rattata-gnawing-teeth.name: Gnawing Teeth
rattata-gnawing-teeth.description: Deals 8% more damage per consecutive hit on the same foe (up to 3).

rattata-survivor.name: Survivor
rattata-survivor.description: Deals 20% more damage while below half HP.

rattata-street-tough.name: Street Tough
rattata-street-tough.description: Cannot be put to Sleep or Slowed.

rattata-double-edge.name: Double-Edge
rattata-double-edge.description: New skill: a reckless full-body charge into a foe (Power 90).

rattata-cornered-rat.name: Cornered Rat
rattata-cornered-rat.description: Deals 20% more damage while 2+ foes stand next to it.

rattata-rat-race.name: Rat Race
rattata-rat-race.description: Steps away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

rattata-giga-impact.name: Giga Impact
rattata-giga-impact.description: New skill: crashes into a foe with all its might (Power 100), pushing it 1 hex.

rattata-hunger.name: Hunger
rattata-hunger.description: Gains 1 Attack for the battle each time it knocks out a foe (max +3).

rattata-frenzy.name: Frenzy
rattata-frenzy.description: Knocking out a foe on its turn lets it use its basic attack again.

rattata-hyper-fangs.name: Hyper Fangs
rattata-hyper-fangs.description: Capstone. Deals 25% more damage to foes with any status and 20% more to foes at full HP.

rattata-survivors-grit.name: Survivor's Grit
rattata-survivors-grit.description: Capstone. Survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP; cannot be Poisoned or Burned.

rattata-super-fang.name: Super Fang
rattata-super-fang.description: New skill: bites a foe with its sharp front fangs (Power 65).

rattata-endure.name: Endure
rattata-endure.description: New skill: braces itself to hold on, becoming Protected for 1 turn.

rattata-rapid-spin.name: Rapid Spin
rattata-rapid-spin.description: New skill: spins into a foe (Power 75), then spins free of engagement.

rattata-tail-whip.name: Tail Whip
rattata-tail-whip.description: New skill: wags its tail to lower guards; adjacent foes are Marked for 2 turns.
